reason: A DSH web plugin centered on monitoring and displaying progress for URL downloads, shell and SSH transfers, and workspace file growth through a draggable progress panel.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 网页界面中集中显示 URL 下载、Shell/SSH 传输和工作区文件增长进度的可拖拽面板插件。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that provides a draggable panel for tracking URL downloads, shell and SSH transfers, and file growth in registered workspaces.

capabilities: Downloads files from URLs into workspaces
Tracks shell, SSH, and workspace file-transfer activity
Monitors workspace file growth through periodic scans
Runs curl processes for panel-started downloads
Provides a draggable web overlay for progress, cancellation, and record management
